claims: "Biopic" is a blend of "biographical" and "picture," commonly used since the early 20th century to signify films about real people.
Denzel Washington [gave an intense, transformative performance] in Malcolm X.
Rami Malek [gave an intense, transformative performance] in Bohemian Rhapsody.
Selma (2014) [is a biopic that] centers on a pivotal, short-term experience that defines their legacy.
Users on Reddit say the pronunciation of "biopic" can be either 'bio-pic' or 'bi-OP-ic'.
Filmmakers sometimes face criticism for altering facts [in biopics], as noted on TV Tropes.
Biopics often include artistic liberty to make the story more engaging or to "signify the truth" of the subject's life in a condensed format, according to TV Tropes.
